title: Three Years and One Short Bell
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：option　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 option 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the headmaster ① kept the option that no student in the school would have recorded, and he said the keeping was the whole of the year. The ② option, meaning the choice itself and not the bell, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; an option, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ option in that school had the same short bell beside it, and the ④ option at the far gate, meaning the prize they kept for the children to win and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An option, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the headmaster said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the option was the whole of the matter, meaning the freedom and not the choice. The ⑥ option, meaning the freedom and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; option, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a choice and a freedom. He said the freedom is the part they remember.

By 1986 the ⑦ option had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short bell. The ⑧ option of the whole thing, the headmaster wrote in October, was one school and three years of recording; option, he said, is either the prize at the far gate or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ option I remember is the choice recorded in the record, which closed in 1988 and is still recorded as the quietest in the school. An ⑩ option, my mother said in 1990, is the only choice that improves by being recorded; every option, she said, is a freedom that has agreed to look like a choice. She said the freedom was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 选择；选项（指学堂里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 选择；选项（指那个选择本身，与小小的铜铃相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep the option 留着这一个选择
D. n. 选择；选项（指留给孩子们争的那一份）
E. n. 选择之事（抽象总称，指一处学堂的选择之事）
F. n. 选择；选项（指学籍册里写到、被记载的那一个）
G. n. 选择、余地（指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 余地（抽象总称，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept the option that no student in the school would have recorded
The option, meaning the choice itself and not the bell
the option at the far gate
the option was the whole of the matter
the option had become a line in a record
The option of the whole thing
An option, my mother said in 1990

answers.why: keep the option 意为“留着这一个选择”，1981 年那位校长把学堂里没有一位学生肯记载的一个选择做了一遍。
option 意为“选择；选项”，指那个选择本身而不是小小的铜铃，它经过了三个学年而在簿子上没有被记载。
option 意为“选择；选项”，指学堂里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一只小小的铜铃。
option 意为“选择；选项”，指最远那道校门的留给孩子们争的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
option 意为“选择、余地”，指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个余地就是那件事的全部。
option 意为“余地”，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个选择，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
option 意为“选择；选项”，指学籍册里写到、被记载的那一个，到 1986 年这一个成了学籍册里的一行。
option 意为“选择之事”，校长十月写道，整件事的选择之事是一处学堂和三个学年的记载。
option 意为“选择；选项”，我记得的是学籍册里记载过的那一个，1988 年办完了，至今仍被说成学堂里最安静的一个。
option 为抽象总称，母亲 1990 年说，选择是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的选择。
